{{Quote|Our Adarian-style donuts are made fresh daily by a genuine Crisp-E-O donut droid. Bright and early every morning, our Crisp-E-O unit sorts through its database of more than 2,400 donut recipes to choose the delicious varieties to be made that day using its internal oil fryer. You never know when you'll discover a new favorite. (If you get the chance, be sure to try the dianoga cream-filled donut--it's divine!)|Dex's Diner menu, on its donuts|<ref name="Menu" />}}
An '''Adarian-style donut''' was a type of [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] that could be made by a [[Crisp-E-O donut droid]]. Once such [[droid]] employed at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], had a database of over 2,400 recipes for Adarian-style donuts, including a [[dianoga cream-filled donut]] which the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]] personally recommended.<ref name="Menu" /> The donuts shared their name with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the planet [[Adari]].<ref name="">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Adarian-style donuts were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
